name.value: Divya Sutra Suites on Robson Downtown Vancouver

description.value: Divya Sutra Suites is an 11-story boutique hotel on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, offering 41 rooms ranging from queen suites to multi-bedroom penthouses, many with full kitchens suitable for self-catering touring cyclists. The location places guests within walking distance of Stanley Park and the world-class seawall cycling network. The hotel is pet-friendly (dogs under 20 lb) and offers 24-hour self-parking with both outdoor and basement options, plus EV car charging.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 36m. Total: 4 spaces.

raw_osm.name: Divya Sutra Suites on Robson Downtown Vancouver

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate 11-story boutique hotel at 1431 Robson St in Vancouver's West End, with address and phone matching OSM. No mention of bike-specific storage anywhere on the website; the 24-hour parking references are for cars (including a caged EV charging area), with no indication bikes can be stored securely overnight. Laundry, luggage storage, and Wi-Fi are all explicitly confirmed by the website; the website title ('Divya Sutra Plaza and Conference Centre') differs from the OSM/hotel-branded name, and the footer contains leftover website-template placeholder text from a Swiss resort, flagged as concerns.
concerns: Website page title reads 'Divya Sutra Plaza and Conference Centre' while the OSM name and hotel branding throughout the site uses 'Divya Sutra Suites on Robson Downtown Vancouver' — possible parent-brand vs. property-name mismatch.
Website footer contains leftover placeholder template content from an unrelated Swiss resort ('The Hoteller Resort Via Serlas 27, 7500 St. Moritz, Switzerland'), indicating incomplete website setup.
OSM address omits unit number (#1) and postal code present on the website; minor discrepancy, same physical location.
EV car charging stations are present (2 spots in caged parking area) but are explicitly described as for cars — no evidence of e-bike-specific charging.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate and active accommodation in an excellent cycling location near Stanley Park, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike-handling procedures are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving both required WWC criteria unconfirmed. Direct inquiry with the property is needed before including in the directory.

Laundry.detail: Coin laundry facility equipped with washers and dryers available every day; daily housekeeping also available

Luggage storage.detail: Front desk will store luggage before check-in if room is not yet ready
